summary: Improve payment-flow controls, settlement-risk monitoring and scheme oversight. Explore the five-day course and its practical operational outputs.
lede: Training in payment systems, instant payments and interoperability helps professionals coordinate payment flows and strengthen operational controls. Designed for payment operations managers, settlement officers and financial-sector compliance professionals, it covers assessing settlement risks, monitoring liquidity and exceptions, mapping message and provider hand-offs, designing fraud escalation workflows, reviewing scheme controls and reporting payment performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, supervise or support payment-system operations across bank, mobile-money, fintech and public-service payment arrangements.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with banking, mobile-money or payment-service operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software for payment-position and performance-indicator exercises.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
